title: W1 Problem & Operating Setup

backup.activationRule: Use only through a Decision Record when Primary cannot meet recruitment, source-availability or founder-access gate.

pilotScope.evidenceBoundary: Selection is an approved test scope, not evidence that demand, content supply or willingness to pay has passed.

recruitmentPlan.completedUserMix: 4 Vientiane residents plus 2 recent Vientiane visitors, each with a recent restaurant search
recruitmentPlan.completedOwnerMix: 2 Lao-food restaurants plus 1 visitor-oriented restaurant plus 1 new or social-media-active restaurant

outcomes.pilotScope: Approved: Primary Chanthabouly restaurants with 30-Place target; Backup Sisattanak restaurants
outcomes.placeCandidates: Enough credible sources to forecast W2 target of 30 Places
outcomes.operations: Actual hours, expense, evidence IDs, blocker and W2 next action recorded

dayPlan.focus: Scope, script, evidence IDs, recruitment and candidate ledger
Theme coding, candidate forecast, expense and W2 handoff

interviewRules: Ask about recent real behavior before showing the solution.
Use neutral follow-ups and separate observation from interpretation.
No audio recording without explicit consent.
Public registers use U-### and O-### subject codes only.
Names, contact details, consent originals and recordings remain in restricted storage.
Verbal interest is not revenue, payment, deposit or LOI.
disclaimer: The Pilot scope is approved and the W1 procedure/templates are ready. Participants, interviews, Place candidates, evidence and expense are not completed until Founder records actual results.
